quote: Assassin’s Creed Shadows – 10/10Assassin’s Creed Shadows is an incredible open-world experience. Its breathtaking depiction of feudal Japan, stunning visuals, immersive atmosphere, and satisfying gameplay make it truly special. Naoe and Yasuke bring a fantastic dynamic to the adventure, while the world is filled with beauty and detail. Ubisoft has delivered one of the most impressive entries in the Assassin’s Creed franchise. Absolutely phenomenal!
